snippet.title: Caromble! - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Caromble! is the ultimate brick breaker. A 3D physics-based adventure that blends brick breaking with pinball, platforming and trickshot puzzles. Guide the ball through a dynamic world, battle challenging bosses, and unlock game-changing powerups. Save the ball. Save the world.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/347660/Caromble/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
